goal: Deliver a streaming-ready mix and 8-stem set for the single 'Salt Harbor', keeping the lead vocal intelligible on phone speakers.
inputs: Reference rough mix from the band's demo
Alt take of the lead vocal (comp candidate)
Tempo map approved by the producer
constraints: No reverb on the lead vocal verse
Guitars must stay under the vocal in the 2-4 kHz range
references: Describe the dry, close vocal texture and narrow stereo drum image of the band's demo
Analyse the low-mid weight of the reference mix, do not copy its arrangement
audience: Indie-rock listeners on phone speakers and car systems
platform: Spotify + Apple Music, plus Bandcamp stem bundle
stem_format: 24-bit/48kHz WAV, 8 stems (drums, bass, gtr L, gtr R, keys, lead vox, bgv, fx)
notes: Producer owns final approval. Session backup verified before any destructive edit.
